Description
Beautifully renovated 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom detached home in total located in prestigious West Point Grey, one of Vancouver Westside’s most desirable neighborhoods. Offering spacious and comfortable living in a prime location, within the Lord Byng Secondary School catchment. The price is only for the upstairs two bedrooms, one dinning room and one family room, with separate entry and private Landry room.
